scope: Selected source-verified counterevidence to historical O1-O8; not a complete review of every historical assertion

corrections.claim: Process topology is exhausted by three ONNX-bearing processes
corrections.correction: Optional Windows Nemotron native CLI and HTTP Whisper routes exist in addition to those three; model runner is not another STT recognizer in this integration.

corrections.claim: Catalog is rebuildable without user data loss
corrections.correction: Curated memory and diarization are not journal-derived. Deleting catalog loses them; reindexing existing catalog is distinct.
Store::open discards checkpoint outcome then copies main DB only; maintenance uses a separate VACUUM INTO/fallback path. Source patterns alone do not establish concurrency/power-loss durability.

corrections.claim: VAD max utterance duration implies bounded complete STT pipeline
corrections.correction: 10-second input buffer cap is real but queued PCM-owning spawned tasks acquire permits later; total queued memory is not bounded by that cap.

corrections.claim: Worker upgrades Slint Weak then schedules UI mutation
corrections.correction: Representative delta path clones Weak to invoke_from_event_loop closure and upgrades on UI thread. Do not assume upgraded component is Send.

corrections.claim: Settings stays instantiated for the entire process lifetime
corrections.correction: Reuse path exists while slot is Some, but explicit close callback sets slot None; behavior differs between hide/reuse and explicit destruction.

corrections.claim: Stealth exclusion is enforced on every auxiliary-window reveal
corrections.correction: apply_stealth_one logs failure without success return and reveal moves on-screen unconditionally. Native visible leak remains to reproduce.

corrections.claim: All internal endpoint/username data is sanitized from diagnostics
corrections.correction: Visible readiness details are assigned directly; URL path/query redaction is incomplete. Sanitized HTTP status logging does not imply all UI diagnostics are sanitized.

corrections.claim: High-risk or multi-crate ordinary work requires manual Full gate
corrections.correction: Current root policy chooses targeted checks for normal development/prereleases, Full only explicit owner-authorized stable publication. Do not carry old blanket Full wording forward.

corrections.claim: Process isolation automatically prevents license contamination
corrections.correction: Process topology prevents runtime collisions, not automatic licensing clearance. Runtime/model grants, notices and upstream provenance require separate review; no legal certification supplied.

corrections.claim: macOS global stealth rejects unsupported operation and self-capture is separately filtered
corrections.correction: Global capability false and enabled affinity returns Err; ScreenCaptureKit excludes own application/windows for internal screenshot. This does not establish exclusion from external apps.
